name: Saône-et-Loire
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay and Pinot Noir sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A French IGP for the Saône-et-Loire département. Across all the département's vineyards, whatever name the wine is sold under, Chardonnay leads with about 57% of vines, followed by Pinot Noir and Gamay.
